decisions.statement: MusicBrainz is asked no more than once every 1100 milliseconds.
One queue has every ask this module makes.
An ask that fails waits as long as an ask that answers.
Every ask names Alan's email address in its user agent.
A browse takes 100 rows at a time.
A browse ends once the count MusicBrainz gives is reached.
An answer that is no 200 is thrown rather than returned.

definition: MusicBrainz asked for an artist, the works and the recordings
